name: passport-funder
description: Self-hosted onboarding funder for Midnight Passport: drips activation-sized NIGHT to brand-new wallets, and sponsors .night registrations outright so a Passport never has to hold NIGHT at all.
//compact-runtime: 0.16.0 is what the ledger-8 Midnames build this service bundles demands:
its `checkRuntimeVersion('0.16.0')` is a hard failure on anything else.
It used to be expressed as an `overrides` block here, which npm ignores in
a workspace package — it only reads the root's. It happened to resolve
correctly anyway, because the demo asked for 0.16.0 too and npm hoisted it.
The demo has since moved to ledger-9, so the hoisted copy is 0.18.0-rc.1
and this service needs its own. Declaring it as a real dependency is what
makes that happen; the inert `overrides` block has been dropped rather than
left to look as though it were doing the work.
